caption: The drawing depicts a single, tall glass bottle with a stopper. The bottle has a bulbous body that tapers to a narrow neck, and it is capped with a rounded, knobbed stopper that sits atop a flat rim. The bottle and stopper are rendered in shades of blue, with darker blue used for shadows and contours, and lighter blue for highlights and reflective surfaces, suggesting transparency and the reflective qualities of glass. Vertical lines run from the base to the neck, providing a sense of form, curvature, and texture. The drawing appears centered on a plain, pale background, with a thin, double-line border framing the composition. The artist's signature, "G. Capelli," is located in the lower left corner within the bordered area.
title: Toilet Water Bottle
